title: Up to 10 years of tax relief? Not for every business.

lines: A ten-year tax break sounds compelling.
In San Salvador's Historic Center, qualifying new investments may receive up to ten years of tax relief.
Before counting the savings, check three things: the exact location, the qualifying investment, and the required approval.
Then ask the question that matters: who actually receives the benefit?
A landlord's approval does not automatically extend to the tenant.
Follow Aurora for the economics behind expansion — not just the headline incentives.
